description: NFX-07 §2 pay/1 messages: one JSON object per line (NDJSON), at most 32 KiB with its newline, under the NFX-11 §9 value rules. Every 'valid' wire parses to its 'message' (unknown fields dropped); every 'valid_with_loopback' wire parses only where a deployment allows loopback http mints, and is refused by default; every 'invalid' wire MUST be refused.

invalid.name: line-of-32768-bytes
invalid.why: a line is at most 32 KiB, newline included
